extracted.intended_audience: general educated public; parents and readers interested in child hygiene, diet, and social/political theory
extracted.subtask_description: Prescriptive guidance and explanatory claims about physical education (especially diet for children) together with an essay on political integration: describing conditions, mechanisms, and consequences of social/political consolidation and dissolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural food principle (Haller's maxim)
rubrics_metrics.description: “Our proper nutriment should consist of vegetable and semi-animal substances which can be eaten with relish before their natural taste has been disguised by artificial preparation.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid excessive grinding, bolting, leavening, cooking, spicing, heating, and freezing; prefer whole, palatable natural products to concentrated extracts and compounds (e.g., bran-flour better than bolted flour; fresh fruits, nuts, and milk preferred to meat-extracts and pure glucose).

rubrics_metrics.name: Breastfeeding and weaning timing
rubrics_metrics.description: “The appearance of the eye-teeth (cuspids) and lesser molars marks the end of the second year as the period when healthy children may be gradually accustomed to semi-fluid vegetable substances. Till then, milk should form their only sustenance.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As substitute for mother's milk, cow's-milk mixed with a little water and sugar is recommended over patent paps and commercial baby food (which may induce dysenteric complaints like 'weaning-brash').

rubrics_metrics.name: Early soft foods recommendation for weanlings
rubrics_metrics.description: Young weanlings do best on simple, semi-fluid vegetable substances and porridges.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Porridge of milk and boiled rice or oatmeal with a little sugar or spoonfuls of apple-butter is recommended; allow a child to eat its fill of such simple dishes, but serve at regular intervals and never hot.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meal frequency and establishment of routine
rubrics_metrics.description: Begin feeding with five light meals a day, gradually reduce to three, and thereafter observe a system of fixed hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishing periodicity of appetite saves parents from constant snacking provision and cultivates regular appetite rhythms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Temperature of served food
rubrics_metrics.description: Heating our food is one of the many devices for disguising its natural taste and is harmful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Never serve nursery foods hot; high temperature facilitates deglutition but reduces insalivation and makes food less digestible by forcing the stomach to perform jaw/salivary work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoidance of hot spices and stimulants
rubrics_metrics.description: Hot spices irritate the stomach and cause it to discharge ingesta rapidly, preventing formation of healthy chyle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spices do not aid digestion; prefer non-stimulating condiments (e.g., honey, vanilla in moderation) and avoid caustic spices and intoxicating fluids especially in children.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bolting/grinding and artificial concentration are abuses
rubrics_metrics.description: By bolting our flour and extracting nutritive principle of liquids we mechanically perform digestive functions, producing concentrated nutriment that is less wholesome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer less-processed grains (bran-flour) and whole foods; concentrated extracts (meat extracts, pure glucose) are generally inferior to palatable natural products.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progressive diet transition by dentition
rubrics_metrics.description: At the end of the second year introduce semi-fluid vegetable substances; toward the end of the seventh year the advent of a second sturdier set of teeth suggests exercising the jaws on more solid substances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A child of seven should 'graduate to a seat at the family table'; the family table should offer nothing the child cannot digest, and parents should regulate fare by hygiene rather than etiquette until habits are established.

rubrics_metrics.name: Children's suitability for vegetarian diet
rubrics_metrics.description: Healthy children of five take readily to an exclusively vegetable diet, which is often preferable to city milk and always to flesh-food.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommend baked apples, pulses, macaroni, whipped eggs, bread-pudding, mellow fruits; allow children variety and to eat until satisfied of simple vegetable dishes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seasonal variation of diet
rubrics_metrics.description: Vary the regimen with the weather; adopt a special summer diet as culinary abuses are more harmful in summer than in winter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: From May to September fresh fruit ought to form the staple of diet; the noonday meal should be cold dishes (e.g., cold apple-pudding with sweet milk and whipped eggs, strawberries with bread, cream, and sugar).

rubrics_metrics.name: Digestibility of fats and seasonal suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: All kinds of fat are more digestible in winter than in summer; cold air is a peptic stimulant and neutralizes calorific effect of non-nitrogenous diet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjust fat intake seasonally; rely more on fresh fruits in summer and richer dairy/fats in cold months as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Milk and dairy guidance (fresh preferred)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sweet fresh milk is the most wholesome semi-animal substance; sour milk is generally eschewed by animals and repulsive to a normal man.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Butter and cream (though less digestible than fresh milk) are healthier than sour whey and cheese; some cheeses (e.g., Limburger) are compared to putrid curd and judged unwholesome.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical stance on adulteration and dietary purism
rubrics_metrics.description: Minor market adulterations (a little tallow, oleomargarine, lard in butter) are trivial compared to larger dietetic evils.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid over-focusing on trifling purity issues while neglecting major dietary harms ('We cannot afford to fight gnats while beset by a swarm of vampires').

rubrics_metrics.name: Role of exercise in mitigating gastric uneasiness
rubrics_metrics.description: Gastric uneasiness after a hearty meal of meat often yields readily to exercise in open air.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical activity, especially outdoors, counteracts some deleterious effects of rich or heavy meals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measured view on flesh-food (meat)
rubrics_metrics.description: Meat is 'certainly not our natural food' according to author, and its frequent use may produce gastric uneasiness, distressing dreams, restlessness, and mood changes; yet its deleterious effects have been overrated and occasional use is acceptable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where choice is limited, mixed diet is preferable to starch-only; in cold climates a modicum of fat is necessary but need not come from slaughtered animals; eggs, mollusks, crustaceans, and fish are often acceptable substitutes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eggs and seafood as acceptable animal-foods
rubrics_metrics.description: Objections to flesh-food do not apply to eggs and less to mollusks and crustaceans; fish are almost as digestible as potatoes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On journeys and in cold weather, children may be occasionally indulged with codfish-balls, oiled sardines, and ham-sandwiches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Weaning practices and cultural examples
rubrics_metrics.description: In some cultures children are nursed longer; Ionian-Islanders let toddling infants partake of parents' simple repast (maize-cakes and dried figs), exercising their teeth on corn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cultural practices suggest flexibility: mothers whose employment allows may safely nurse longer; early introduction of family foods can be appropriate where diet is simple.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural seasonal adaptation of foods
rubrics_metrics.description: Seasons furnish foods adapted to preservation of the right medium temperature of the system: preserved fruits become less acidic but nutritive; cow's milk grows richer in winter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exploit seasonal availability (fruits in warm months, richer dairy in winter) to match physiological needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scale of wholesomeness for cooked vegetable substances
rubrics_metrics.description: Vegetable substances whose pleasant taste has been restored by cooking occupy the place next to the ideal natural diet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cooking that restores pleasant taste without excessive processing is acceptable, especially in frigid latitudes where cooking has advantages for preservation and digestibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Children's dental and ingestion practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternating hot and cold drinks harms the teeth more than appetite for sweetmeats; encourage proper chewing and insalivation rather than bolting food.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote chewing, avoid bolting and alternating extreme temperatures in drinks/foods to protect dental health and digestive effectiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political integration: decrease of restraints with industrial type
rubrics_metrics.description: As societies shift from militant to industrial types, restraints the social aggregate exercises over units decrease because industrial societies have larger populations and cohesion arises from pecuniary interests, family bonds, and love of country.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Political integration via growth (increase of mass) tends toward voluntary cooperation replacing compulsory union; policy analysis should recognize different mechanisms in militant vs industrial societies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods of incorporation during social growth
rubrics_metrics.description: Small aggregates incorporate material for growth by petty predation (taking game, robbing women, adopting men); larger aggregates incorporate wholesale via enslavement and bodily annexation; compound aggregates develop desires to absorb neighboring societies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand historical progression of incorporation mechanisms when evaluating processes of state formation and expansion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental and physiological conditions affecting social consolidation
rubrics_metrics.description: Habitat suitability for large populations, facilities for intercourse (communication/transport), presence or absence of natural barriers, and antecedent racial traits (physical, emotional, intellectual capacities) further or hinder social growth and consolidation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess geographic, infrastructural, and demographic preconditions when analyzing potential for political integration or state durability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Likeness among units as a condition for integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Degree of likeness (blood ties, common traditions, common male ancestor, joint worship) among units facilitates cohesion; societies held together only by force tend to disintegrate when force fails.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promote shared institutions and cultural commonalities to foster durable integration; expect limits when unlikenesses are large.

rubrics_metrics.name: External threat and war as active causes of integration
rubrics_metrics.description: Joint reaction against external action and cooperation in war produce social integration: temporary unions for offense/defense, if prolonged, create coherent groups under common control.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated common defense behaviors generate institutional cohesion; analyze conflict dynamics as drivers of political consolidation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration reduces separateness and obliterates original divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Political integration tends to erase original gentile/tribal divisions, dissolve separate local organizations into a common administration, and replace topographical bounds with administrative bounds; conversely, dissolution occurs by large groups separating first and subdividing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect cultural intermingling, administrative centralization, and redrawing of boundaries as integration advances; anticipate reverse sequencing during collapse (large units break apart first).
